title: Swipe deck
description: A stack of cards you go through one at a time, swiping each away. Parts: SwipeDeck (root, one tab stop), SwipeDeckStack (the stage), SwipeDeckCard (any content as children, `value` is its identity), SwipeDeckLabel (turns `left`, `right` or `up` on for its card; frosts the whole card with its icon as the drag goes, in its button's colour: `variant` outline (milky) or default (copper); its word is announced), SwipeDeckEmpty (shown once no card is left), SwipeDeckActions with SwipeDeckAction (a Button per direction) and SwipeDeckUndo. The drag locks to an axis, follows 1:1 toward a labelled direction, rubber-bands elsewhere, commits past a threshold or on a flick, else springs home. The deck owns the order and a 10-step history: onSwipe(card, direction, { via }) fires as a card leaves (return false to keep it); undo (button, Backspace, Cmd+Z / Ctrl+Z, undo()) brings it back and calls onUndo. Keyboard: Left, Right, Up; the label is announced. Only a dragged card has a shadow. Reduced motion cross-fades. No copy inside.
